verdicts.reason: The two candidates are essentially identical; only the bottom-left dot cluster differs, by a pixel or two. Both share the same flaws. 'WORLD'S' and 'Biggest Plants' start at different left edges. The headline is too small for a story format. The short horizontal rule floats on its own and crosses the edge of the cooling-tower photo. The dotted ornaments are scattered across the white space. There is a large dead white band at the bottom, and the two photos sit on unrelated left edges, so the layout looks stacked rather than designed.
